usage.callShape: POST https://api.hookfindr.com/api/x402/transcribe with JSON body {"url":"<public short-form video URL>"}
usage.outputShape: body.text (full transcript string); body.words[] (array of {word, start, end} timestamps in seconds); body.word_count; body.transcript_source (e.g. "whisper_v3_turbo"); body.duration_s; body.source/body.cached (cache flags); body.music and body.summary may be null
quirks: MUST send the video URL in a JSON POST body as {"url":"..."} — the bazaar payment-required header advertises input as type:http with queryParams:{url}, but passing ?url=... as a query param returns HTTP 400 {"error":"invalid json"} AND STILL CHARGES (lost $0.05 on the query-param attempt).
Input is a PUBLIC short-form VIDEO URL (TikTok/YouTube/Shorts/Instagram Reels/Twitter-X/Twitch/Facebook, ~1000 platforms via yt-dlp), NOT an audio file URL.
Uses native platform captions when available (~2s) and falls back to Whisper-large-v3-turbo on extracted audio (~30s); known songs return LRCLIB synced lyrics instead.
Responses are cached: re-calling the same video URL returns source:"cache", cached:true (you still pay $0.05 per call).
usage.guide: POST to https://api.hookfindr.com/api/x402/transcribe with a JSON body {"url":"<public video URL>"} (Content-Type application/json) and pay the $0.05 x402 charge on Base. Do NOT pass the URL as a query parameter — that returns 400 invalid json yet still charges you. The url must be a public short-form video link (TikTok, YouTube, Shorts, Instagram Reels, X, Twitch, Facebook, etc.). Read the transcript from body.text and per-word timestamps from body.words[] ({word,start,end} in seconds); transcript_source tells you whether native captions or Whisper was used. Synchronous — the full result is in the paid response, no polling.
